svg.text: Sketch, not data: floors, rooms, bridges, tunnels and wrecks, and roughly how big. +X (right) is east, north is up. Every number is tunable in content data.
Not to scale for distances. Giant ~1.2–1.4× the home planet.
fly in: gas fog + packed rocks
no wall, you crash and die
Floors 10 m apart, counted from the bottom. Tunnels join the towers at every level they share. The bay's tunnel leaves the main market floor.
~76 m across, the port pit's size
drop hatch: ~35 m down to wreck 1 (panel below)
Below the station: three wrecked cruisers in the belt

Smaller scale than the station panel. The desert wreck's 600 m hull, staggered so each deck shows past the one above. Each lower one also sits a hull-width north (paler = further back), so it lies beside the one above, not under it. Jetpack drops ~35–40 m (1.8 s of fuel brakes a ~45 m fall). Same droids and prize crate on each.
wreck 3: tilted, a hull-width further north
or fly down and land on wreck 1
fall past the last wreck: dead (the belt)
Main tower: 4 floors, top to bottom
Every floor: elevator in the open middle, 2 bridges to it, a gallery round the gap, rooms, then the outer hallway behind a glass wall. Room windows face space through it.
N-S bridges · general + honour guard on the bridge
N-S bridges · stalls + grey metal huts, no rooms
Second tower: 3 floors, top to bottom
Smaller across. Its floors line up with the main tower's floors 4, 3 and 2, and a tunnel joins each pair.
E-W bridges · stalls + grey metal huts
bridge to the elevator (2 per floor, alternating N-S / E-W)
outer hallway, glass outer wall (blue rim)
open home: bed, kitchen, lounge, 2–3 people
Floors are counted from the bottom (1) up.
Tunnels: main 4 to T2 homes, main 3 to T2 outpost,
main 2 to T2 markets. The bay's tunnel leaves
the main market floor to the west.
